The issuer exhibits solid profitability and operating cash generation with revenue of $6.93B, an EBIT margin of ~13.5% ($938M), and net income of $653M. However, creditworthiness is constrained by high leverage (total liabilities of $7.47B against equity of $1.60B, resulting in a debt-to-equity ratio of ~4.67x) and a weak liquidity profile indicated by a current ratio below 1.0 (0.91x). These fundamentals align with an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the BBB category.

DECISION: BBB
